summary: Sister of Helen (Ferlaino) Cognetti, born in Pennsylvania about 1904; John's 2nd great-grandaunt.
bio: Raffaela Ferlaino was born in Pennsylvania about 1904 or 1905, a sister of Helen (Ferlaino) Cognetti. The 1920 census recorded her, aged 15, as 'Rofella' in the family household. She is John's 2nd great-grandaunt.
